First, I'm really sorry for being this person, but I find this feature is reactionary and crosses and certain line.

For reference, this is a new feature implemented recently.

Going hand-in-hand with the ideas of freedom of speech and expression is the notion of privacy. It's a bit subtle how that is applied here, but in short, a single compromise will reveal to an attacker every vote you've cast on this site since the feature was implemented. While your IP address is not is legally viable as an identifier in an American court of law, not all of us are subject to American courts and not all of us are primarily concerned with the legal authorities.

For example, if you are browsing from work, and are the only or one of a few people using voat at work, you are instantly identified. I'm sure you can follow this train of thought from here.

While it would appear improbable that more than one user will be voting on the same content from the same IP (and thus being prevented from doing so), it really isn't that far fetched, especially as the site grows.

Currently, you can technically circumvent the logging of your actual IP by using TOR or a VPN. The same workaround can be used by people attempting to manipulate votes (and you can bet that it is). However, browsing over TOR is at times prohibitively slow and reliable VPNs cost extra money.

While I realize it's rather moot and ineffectual in the grand scheme of things, I have not and will not be voting on anything until this feature is either rescinded or modified to properly protect our privacy. I love this site want to help it continue to grow, so I'll keep submitting content and interacting, but having to choose between having my IP stored for every vote I cast and jumping through hoops to make sure it stores the wrong IP isn't something I find worth doing.

:(

Edit: It's fixed!
Stop storing IP address for every vote until the data can be properly protected

The solution seems simple: Don't store IPs. Store hashes of IPs.

Hashes of IP + post/comment ID + a salt concatenated together would provide more privacy and still allow voat to check if the same IP is voting on the same thing.

That way an adversary could not simply make a hash of the IP they are looking for and find all posts they voted on. The adversary in my solution would have to make a hash for every IP they are interested in times every post they could have voted on.
